build_order: intake-validation domain (Sensor Metric Boundary, sample, validation status)
intake-validation application and WebFlux ingress endpoint
sequencing-windowing domain and application (60s reorder window, sliding window)
event-ledger domain, repository port, R2DBC adapter, read endpoints
stream-broadcasting application, sink adapter, SSE/stream endpoint
in-process reactive event wiring between contexts

module_layout.integration: Single deployable; contexts communicate only through published events (TelemetrySampleValidated/ValidationFailed, TelemetrySampleSequenced, TelemetryBackfillDetected, TelemetryWindowClosed) over bounded Reactor sinks with explicit backpressure; no cross-context domain type imports. Edge devices -> Intake via WebFlux open-host packet contract; Broadcasting -> consumers via stable stream contract. Externalized config (application.yml): reorder window (60s), sliding window size/slide, buffer capacities, per-metric boundaries, timeouts.

persistence.storage_paradigm: Relational time-series, append-only, owned by Telemetry Event Ledger only
persistence.data_model: telemetry_record (id, device_id, metric, value, t_device, t_ingress, validation_status, revision, supersedes_id); no UPDATE/DELETE; corrections append a new revision row
queries: history by device and t_device range ordered by t_device
persistence.migration_plan: Expand-only Flyway migrations run at build/startup; indexes on (device_id, t_device)
persistence.backup_recovery: Periodic snapshots plus WAL archiving; ledger is rebuildable only from source, so retain backups
open_questions: Handling of samples later than 60s (assumed revision via ledger)

risks: Backpressure ownership split between Intake and Broadcasting is ambiguous
Samples later than 60s reorder window unspecified
Downstream consumer identity and window size/slide unspecified
Blocking I/O accidentally introduced on ingestion path
Memory growth of reorder buffers under burst load without bounded capacity
Eventual consistency between ledger and broadcast
